reasons: B gives a single, coherent 4-hour server window on Sunday with a timed runbook, a restore test, a final backup and a plan B. A splits the rack move across Saturday (shutdown and loading 09:00-13:00) and Sunday (mounting and power-on), which would keep the server off far longer than 4 hours, and its furniture delivery dates are miscalculated. B orders the internet and furniture earlier with correct working-day arithmetic, though its deadline statements are somewhat inconsistent and it has minor typos.

A: Furniture ordered Mon 9 Nov with a 5-working-day lead time arrives Mon 16 Nov, not Thu 19 / Fri 20 Nov
Claims furniture ordered after Thu 12 Nov arrives on the 23rd; an order on Fri 13 Nov arrives Fri 20 Nov
The server plan has shutdown and loading on Saturday 09:00-13:00 and mounting and power-on on Sunday, which breaks the 4-hour limit
B: The week-1 note says furniture ordered after 13 Nov will not arrive, which conflicts with its own 6 Nov deadline; an order on 13 Nov arrives 20 Nov
Internet deadline given as 3-4 Nov in the table, although an order on 6 Nov still connects by 20 Nov (inconsistent with its own week-1 note)
